# Targeted evidence and proposal pass

For each assigned ID, conduct a targeted credible-source search and focused reads of exact sources that can resolve the listed blocker. Record source title/publisher/date, concrete facts, exact support for or contradiction of the original claim, and limitations. If the original claim is unsupported, do not pad: propose a corrected grounded claim and usable short/medium/long descriptions, or an explicit exclusion proposal with rationale. If evidence remains insufficient, state what was checked and the exact remaining gap. Output append-only full-schema rows with an evidence_resolution object containing outcome (corrected_claim, explicit_exclusion, or still_unresolved), evidence_review, proposed_claim, proposed_descriptions, exclusion_reason, and missing_evidence as applicable. These are proposals only: no live DB/index mutation. Work only your owner packet, preserve prior rows, use batches of 5-10, checkpoint and push to your existing task branch. No Web IDs, children, installs, merge or deploy. GPT-6 Luna low.
